response.overview: This short student auto-documentary narrates a day in Ngari Mulholland's life that she believes changed her, resembling a format similar to the Australian MY:24 documentary series. It explores, despite being young, the presence of an impactful life lesson through a retrospective lense and ventures into personal discovery, teenagehood and a hopefulness in her inner person that she carries in her life now.
response.title: Polygala Paniculata
